sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Pings are a way to communicate with teammates without using chat.
They can be used to coordinate team actions and warn about threats.
By effectively communicating through pings, you can keep typing
to a minimum and increase your chance to win.

sections.title: Quick Ping
sections.text:
To use a Quick Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button] on interactive targets.
To customize it, look for Quick Ping in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Capture Camp
sections.text:
Malfurion wants to capture Siege Camp
You can use a Quick Ping on a Mercenary Camp to point out that
it is time to start clearing it, so that your teammates do not forget
to do it. Ping earlier if you do not want them to be late.
This way you will also help players who are not familiar
with Mercenary Camp timings at understanding when to do them.

sections.title: Get Objective
sections.text:
E.T.C. wants to collect Tribute
You can use a Quick Ping on a Map Objective to ask your
teammates to collect/capture it because you are ready to
zone for them or you are busy doing
something else. Heroes that are good at zoning should
ideally not be channeling Objectives.

sections.title: Push Structure
sections.text:
Sylvanas wants to push Tower
You can use a Quick Ping on a Structure to tell your teammates to
target it or that you ideally want to destroy it before retreating.
This is particularly useful when going for a Tower and both Towers
near a Gate are up, or when an allied Hero gets thrown behind the enemy
Gate and you need quickly to destroy a side Wall to get them out.

sections.title: Kill Hero
sections.text:
Anub'arak wants to kill Whitemane
You can use a Quick Ping on an enemy Hero in-vision to tell your
teammates to kill them. This is a way to communicate that it is important
to kill that Hero first or that you want to focus damage on that Hero
to secure a kill, avoiding damaging multiple Heroes and killing none.

sections.title: Kill Mercenary
sections.text:
Uther wants to kill Boss
You can use a Quick Ping on an enemy Mercenary in lane to tell your
teammates to kill them. This is a way to communicate that it is important
to kill that Mercenary as soon as possible, before nearby Structures
take too much damage or get completely destroyed. This is mostly
useful for Bosses, but can also be used for other Mercenaries.

sections.title: Need Help
sections.text:
Ana needs help!
You can use a Quick Ping on yourself to tell your teammates to help you.
This is particularly useful when you are being dove
while playing a Hero with no (or almost none) peeling
tools and low survivability (for example Ana).

sections.title: Healing Fountain
sections.text:
Diablo needs to drink from Healing Fountain
You can use a Quick Ping on a Healing Fountain to tell your
teammates that you need to drink from it. This way they will
know that you cannot help them for a few moments. This is better
than pinging your Health Bar or Resource Bar (as explained
in the corresponding sections) because sometimes you may
want to pre-tap (using your Healing Fountain right before
a fight when almost full Health and Mana).

sections.title: Danger Ping
sections.text:
To use a Danger Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button], move your mouse cursor upwards, and then release.
To customize it, look for Quick Ping in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Dangerous Area
sections.text:
Tyrande warns this area is dangerous!
You can use a Danger Ping to tell your teammates that a given area
is dangerous because there are enemy Heroes hiding nearby or because
an enemy Hero put something harmful there (for example
Steel Trap by Junkrat).

sections.title: Stealth Hero
sections.text:
Garrosh warns this area is dangerous!
You can use a Danger Ping to signal that you spotted an enemy Hero in Stealth
near that location. Considering that Stealth prevents Heroes to be seen
on the Minimap, it is quite useful to use pings for them.

sections.title: Dangerous Hero
sections.text:
Varian warns that Garrosh is dangerous!
You can use a Danger Ping on an enemy Hero to let your teammates know
they are a threat and they should be respecting them. This is useful
when facing Heroes with powerful Abilities who can easily get a kill
(for example Stitches with Gorge).

sections.title: Bad Positioning
sections.text:
Uther warns Jaina is in danger!
You can use a Danger Ping on an allied Hero to let them know
they are standing in a dangerous spot, a choke point, or where
your team lacks vision. This way they will hopefully notice their
mistake and move to a safer position before it is too late.

sections.title: Enemy Nearby
sections.text:
Varian warns this area is dangerous!
You can use a Danger Ping where you think enemy Heroes could
engage, flank,
invade a Mercenary Camp, or gank.
This is meant to raise awareness, to make your teammates
faster at responding to threats.

sections.title: Invade Risk
sections.text:
Valla warns this area is dangerous!
You can use a Danger Ping on a Mercenary Camp to communicate
that you believe the enemy team is on it and your team needs to
make a play based on that: take down Structures nearby or, if they
are on a Boss Camp on a Map with 2 of them,
capture the other one.

sections.title: Cheese Risk
sections.text:
Mal'Ganis warns that Sgt. Hammer is dangerous!
Mal'Ganis warns this area is dangerous!
Mal'Ganis warns this area is dangerous!
You can use a Quick Ping on an enemy Hero (for example Sylvanas)
followed by a Danger Ping on top lane and bottom lane at the start of the game
to let your team know that the enemy team could go there immediately
and push. If you are near them, defend. If you are too far
from that lane, just push and trade Fort for Fort.

sections.title: Hearthstone
sections.text:
Sgt. Hammer warns this area is dangerous!
Right after returning to the Hall of Storms with your Hearthstone,
you can use a Danger Ping on yourself or around you to communicate
that you are far away from the action and they need to wait for you.

sections.title: On My Way Ping
sections.text:
To use an On My Way Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button], move your mouse cursor to the right, and then release.
To customize it, look for Quick Ping in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Join Soon
sections.text:
Anduin is on the way!
You can use an On My Way Ping to communicate that you will soon be
in a given location to fight, gank, defend Structures,
contest Objective, heal allied Heroes, or provide support in any way.
This way your teammates could wait for you before making a play
or start baiting enemies right before you get there.

sections.title: Capture Camp
sections.text:
Greymane is on their way to Bruiser Camp!
You can use an On My Way Ping to communicate that you are leaving
your current location to go capture a Mercenary Camp. This way your
team will be warned that you are abandoning them for a bit and
they will realize they have to play safe until you come back.

sections.title: Engage Soon
sections.text:
Hanzo is on the way!
You can use an On My Way Ping right before engaging
(for example Hanzo using Dragon's Arrow),
so that your teammates can go in at the same time and not be late. You can
also do this during a team fight to communicate that you intend to continue
the battle, that you want to chase enemy Heroes.

sections.title: Assist Ping
sections.text:
To use an Assist Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button], move your mouse cursor downwards, and then release.
To customize it, look for Quick Ping in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Mercenary Camp
sections.text:
Hanzo asks for assistance!
You can use an Assist Ping when you or someone else needs help
for capturing a Mercenary Camp as the only Hero who is currently
on that job is not enough. When this ping is used this way,
you generally want the Healer to join.

sections.title: Get Objective
sections.text:
Cassia wants assistance capturing this Seed!
You can use an Assist Ping when you need help
to capture/collect an Objective. This way you
can tell your team that you cannot do it alone
because there are Heroes and/or Monsters nearby.

sections.title: Cover Lane
sections.text:
Tyrande asks for assistance!
You can use an Assist Ping when a lane is empty
and someone should be there to soak.
This way your teammates will notice that someone should go
there in order for your team to not lose precious Experience,
especially in the early game.

sections.title: Reinforcements
sections.text:
Murky asks for assistance!
You can use an Assist Ping when a lane is not empty but you need
reinforcements due to an unfavorable matchup,
due to being outnumbered, or because you cannot win the nearby
Capture Point. The help you need could be in various forms: healing,
waveclear, or ganking.

sections.title: Regeneration Globe
Group Up
sections.text:
Auriel asks for assistance!
You can use an Assist Ping near you to tell your teammates
to group up in a given spot. This is particularly useful
when playing a Healer with
area of effect healing
(for example Auriel).

sections.title: Call Hero
sections.text:
Valla wants to help Malfurion
Valla asks for assistance!
You can use a Quick Ping on an allied Hero followed by an Assist Ping
somewhere else to let that Hero know that their help is needed there.
This is useful when a Hero cannot do Mercenary Camps alone.
Remember to ping beforehand to give them time to react.

sections.title: Defend Ping
sections.text:
To use a Defend Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button], move your mouse cursor to the left, and then release.
To customize it, look for Quick Ping in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Defend Town
sections.text:
Mephisto wants to defend this Fort!
You can use a Defend ping on allied Structure
to tell your teammates that more Heroes are needed there
to defend it from enemy Minions, Mercenaries, or Heroes.
Try to use it as early as possible, otherwise your
teammates will not be there in time.

sections.title: Defend Objective
sections.text:
Probius wants to secure the area!
You can use a Defend ping nearby an Objective
to communicate that you would like your team to
position in a way that does not let the enemy team
get progress on the Objective or to zone
them away while someone is capturing it.

sections.title: Mercenary Camp
sections.text:
Junkrat wants to defend!
You can use a Defend ping nearby a Mercenary Camp
to communicate that you would like your team to
position in a way that does not let the enemy team
invade it or to zone
them away while someone is capturing it.

sections.title: Call Hero
sections.text:
Li Li wants to help Malfurion
Li Li wants to defend!
You can use a Quick Ping on an allied Hero followed by a Defend Ping
in a lane to let that Hero know that their help is needed there.
This is useful when you notice that Structures are taking damage
or are going to take damage soon but your Hero is not capable
to deal with that or you have something else to do.

sections.title: Retreat Ping
sections.text:
To use a Retreat Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to press the [V] key.
To customize it, look for Quick Retreat Ping in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Fall Back
sections.text:
Johanna calls for retreat!
You can use a Retreat Ping whenever you feel like it is not the moment
to fight for any of the following reasons: numerical disadvantage,
lack of resources (low Health and/or Mana), Heroic Abilities on cooldowns,
lost Objective, Talent Tier disadvantage, or useless brawl giving
free Quest progress to enemy Heroes (such as Zul'jin).
When retreating, you should avoid walking on different sides
of impassable terrain from your
teammates otherwise you will not be able to help each other.

sections.title: Give Objective
sections.text:
Chromie calls for retreat!
You can use a Retreat Ping when you want to give the Objective
to the enemy team because, due to a lack of resources or any
other form of disadvantage, your team can no longer win it.
If you do not die, at least you will be able to slow down their
push with the Objective's reward they won.

sections.title: Abandon Town
sections.text:
Nova calls for retreat!
You can use a Retreat Ping when you want to abandon a Fort or Keep
because, due to a lack of resources or any other form of disadvantage,
it can no longer be defended. Dying for a Fort or Keep that
is going to be destroyed anyway will only make things worse.

sections.title: Leave Lane
sections.text:
Dehaka calls for retreat!
You can use a Retreat Ping in a lane when you feel like an allied Hero
should not be there, because you are already there and you are fine
dealing with Minions or Mercenaries alone. This way your teammates
can realize they can go get value elsewhere.

sections.title: Leave Minions
Ability Ping
sections.text:
To use an Ability Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button] on Abilities in the HUD at the bottom of your screen.
To customize it, look for Announce Modifier in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Cooldown
sections.text:
Alexstrasza can use Dragonqueen in 35 seconds!
You can use an Ability Ping to announce that a given Ability
will be ready in x seconds. This is useful
to coordinate engage and
follow-up, to say that your
global is on cooldown,
or to tell your teammates that a key Ability is not available yet.
Here is a list of key Abilities that are important to announce when not ready:
Dragonqueen on Alexstrasza;
Leap of Faith on Anduin;
Phase Shift on Brightwing;
Brushstalker on Dehaka;
Flight on Falstad;
Bio-Kill Switch on Stukov.
At high level of play you may also want to announce the following key Abilities:
Soothing Mist on Brightwing;
Into the Fray on Garrosh;
Let's Go! on Li Li;
Nature's Cure on Malfurion;
Purge on Rehgar;
Hand of Protection on Uther;
Intercession on Whitemane.
Any engage and follow-up Ability
is worth announcing, so that you can better coordinate with your teammates.
An engage without follow-up ready is generally going to be a waste.
Abilities which require a setup have a higher chance to miss
without an engage to keep enemy Heroes in place.
Uther is ready to use Divine Shield!
You can also use an Ability Ping to announce that a given Ability is ready.
This may be useful right before using a Heroic Ability or right after picking
a Heroic Ability that requires your team to be aware of it (for example
Sanctification on Tyrael).
Anduin has 2 charges of Leap of Faith!
When using an Ability Ping on an Ability with charges,
the game will not only say if it is ready but also the amount of charges
currently available. This way you can tell your teammates how many
times you could cast an important Ability in during the next fight.
Maiev is not able to use Naisha's Memento yet!
When using an Ability Ping on an Ability that requires a condition to be met
in order to be usable, the game will simply show it is not usable. This may be
useful for telling your teammates that you cannot do Mercenary Camps without it
(for example Naisha's Memento on Maiev).

sections.title: Low Mana
sections.text:
Uther does not have enough Mana for Holy Light!
You can use an Ability Ping when not having enough Mana
to cast a given Ability to communicate that to your team.
This way your teammates will be warned that, despite being alive,
you can no longer contribute to the fight.

sections.title: Heroic Ability
sections.text:
Anduin is ready to use Lightbomb!
You can use an Ability Ping right after choosing your Heroic Ability to
tell your teammates which one you picked. This may be useful when you pick
a Heroic Ability that requires your team to be aware of it (for example
Sanctification on Tyrael).

sections.title: Hero Ping
sections.text:
To use a Hero Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button] on Heroes in the HUD at the top of your screen.
To customize it, look for Announce Modifier in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Missing Hero
sections.text:
Li Li warns that Genji is missing!
You can use a Hero Ping on a missing enemy Hero to tell your
teammates to be careful. This is best used when enemy Heroes are
rotating from a lane to another or looking
for a gank.

sections.title: Dead Hero
sections.text:
Nova warns that Muradin will respawn in 9 seconds!
You can use a Hero Ping on an enemy Hero to share their respawn time in chat.
If their respawn time is high, it means you want to push the advantage;
if their respawn time is low, it means you have to be careful because
they will respawn soon.
Auriel warns that Valla will respawn in 22 seconds!
You can use a Hero Ping on an allied Hero to share their respawn time in chat.
Regardless of their respawn time, it means you want to play safe
until they come back, otherwise you will be outnumbered and
you will only risk staggering deaths.

sections.title: Talent Tier Ping
sections.text:
To use a Talent Tier Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button] on Team Levels in the HUD at the top of your screen.
To customize it, look for Announce Modifier in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Play Aggressively
sections.text:
Arthas notes that your team has a Talent Tier advantage.
When your team has a Talent Tier advantage or is close to getting it,
you can use a Talent Tier Ping to communicate that you would like to get value
from it, by fighting and/or taking down enemy Structures.
Note that the enemy team will likely try to avoid fighting.

sections.title: Play Defensively
sections.text:
Varian notes that the enemy team has a Talent Tier advantage.
When the enemy team has a Talent Tier advantage or is close to getting it,
you can use a Talent Tier Ping to communicate that you should soak Experience from
Minions and avoid fighting because it will be extremely unlikely to beat them.
Note that the enemy team will likely try to force a fight
or gank someone.

sections.title: Raise Awareness
sections.text:
Varian notes that both teams are on the same Talent Tier.
When neither team has a Talent Tier advantage, you can use a Talent Tier Ping
to tell your teammates to pay attention to Team Levels. If your team is
behind in Experience, it means you want to fight before the enemy team
gets a Talent Tier advantage. If your team is ahead in Experience
or someone in your team needs an important Talent Tier
(for example Varian before Level 4), it means
you want to wait for the next Talent Tier to be unlocked.

sections.title: Health Ping
sections.text:
To use a Health Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button] on your Health Bar in the HUD at the bottom-left corner of your screen.
To customize it, look for Announce Modifier in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Low Health
sections.text:
Tyrael has 12% Health!
You can use a Health Ping to communicate that your Health is low.
This way your teammates will be warned that, despite being alive,
you can no longer contribute to the fight.

sections.title: Resource Ping
sections.text:
To use a Resource Ping with the default Hotkeys, you have to
press [Alt + Left Mouse Button] on your Resource Bar in the HUD at the bottom-left corner of your screen.
To customize it, look for Announce Modifier in the Advanced tab of the Hotkeys window.

sections.title: Low Resource
sections.text:
Lt. Morales has 2% Energy!
You can use a Resource Ping when playing a Hero with a Resource
to communicate that your Mana, Energy, Fury, Rage, or Scrap is low.
This way your teammates will be warned that, despite being alive,
you cannot contribute to the fight for a while. This is particularly useful
if you are the Healer of your team.
